```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)

df_metrics_dec <- read_csv("df_metrics_dec.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

# 只取要比較的三欄：target 與 12 月的 R²
df_r2_compare <- df_metrics_dec %>%
  select(target, R2_12m)

# ---- 繪製 seaborn 風格的箱型圖 + 散點 ----
p <- ggplot(df_r2_compare, aes(x = target, y = R2_12m, fill = target)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.6, outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, alpha = 0.2, size = 1.8) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "borrow_count" = "#4A7BB7",
    "return_count" = "#75A661",
    "net_borrow"   = "#E39D44"
  )) +
  labs(
    title = "Model Predictive Performance Comparison across Targets",
    x = "Target Variable",
    y = "OOS R² (12 月預測)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

print(p)

ggsave("compare_targets_R2.png", p,
       width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```
